objective: Curated visual sourcing for a factual NVIDIA documentary. Prefer real, scene-specific assets over generic technology stock photos.
instructions: Use visual_queries in script.json as the only primary search terms; never concatenate full narration into image searches.
Rank assets by exact title/tag relevance and reject low-relevance candidates rather than filling quotas with unrelated images.
Never use animals, shopping carts, motivational signs, unrelated transport, generic office people, books, or unrelated maps.
For NVIDIA products, select identifiable NVIDIA hardware or clearly label generic infrastructure as illustrative; do not claim generic servers are NVIDIA systems.
Use real, source-attributed images and footage only for factual claims. AI-generated images are disabled for this documentary.
For TSMC manufacturing, label footage as illustrative unless the source confirms the specific facility or process.
Acquire only media with documented reuse terms. NVIDIA newsroom assets are leads for editorial review, not blanket proof of reuse rights.
Prioritize clearly licensed footage from Internet Archive; never imply a generic data-center clip depicts an NVIDIA-owned facility.
Record provider asset ID, original source page, direct media URL, creator, license, attribution, target scene and reason for selection in visual-assets.json.
Upload visual-selection.json, visual-assets.json and contact-sheet.jpg with the final video so selected IDs can be audited.
